name: Riga Technical University
summary: Technical university with 14 English-taught bachelor's in engineering, IT, business and maritime studies, on campuses in Riga and Liepāja.

handoff.label: Bachelor's programmes with EU and non-EU fees

ib.text: No IB-specific page: send your diploma and transcripts (maths and physics grades are read). English B2 is proved by a test unless all schooling was in English; Riga Business School exempts IB holders.

programmes.name: Civil Engineering
programmes.about: Design and construction of buildings, bridges and infrastructure, with digital design tools and practical skills; a three-year academic bachelor taught in English on RTU's Riga campus.
programmes.selectionNote: Online maths entrance exam, motivation letter, reference and online interview; 2026 criteria, 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Engineering Technology, Mechanics and Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: Mechanics and mechanical engineering fundamentals with practical problem-solving and modern digital tools, preparing you to design, analyse and improve mechanical systems.
programmes.selectionNote: Online maths entrance exam, motivation letter, reference and online interview; 2026 criteria, 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Medical Engineering and Physics
programmes.about: Physics and medicine joined, run with Rīga Stradiņš University; tracks include nanomedicine, medical electronics, biomechanics and assistive technologies. 4.5 years.
programmes.selectionNote: Maths exam, interview, motivation letter, reference. RTU page says €5,600; 2027/28 brochure €6,100 (stricter used).

programmes.name: Environmental Engineering
programmes.about: Technical solutions for a zero-pollution, climate-neutral future across environmental engineering, energy and sustainability; a three-year academic bachelor.
programmes.selectionNote: Online maths entrance exam, motivation letter, reference and online interview; 2026 criteria, 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Materials Engineering
programmes.about: Materials science combined with AI, digital technologies and entrepreneurship, aimed at sustainable materials and high-value technologies; three years.
programmes.selectionNote: Online maths entrance exam, motivation letter, reference and online interview; 2026 criteria, 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Computer Systems
programmes.about: The whole software engineering lifecycle, from systems analysis and project management to development and testing, with programming languages, AI fundamentals and databases.
programmes.selectionNote: Online maths entrance exam, motivation letter, reference and online interview; 2026 criteria, 2027 not yet published. Non-EU price is higher.

programmes.name: Telecommunication Technologies and Data Transmission Engineering
programmes.about: Communication systems and large data networks: signal transmission and reception, information security, network interconnection and the design of communication systems.
programmes.ib: Proof of English at CEFR B2; the programme page lists no other subject requirement.
programmes.selectionNote: Online maths entrance exam, motivation letter, reference and online interview; 2026 criteria, 2027 not yet published. Criteria from the RTU programme page.

programmes.name: Smart Electronic Systems
programmes.about: Hands-on electronics engineering: the hardware inside devices from smartphones to satellites; a four-year professional bachelor with an electronics engineer qualification.
programmes.selectionNote: Online maths entrance exam, motivation letter, reference and online interview; 2026 criteria, 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Finance Management Information Systems
programmes.about: FinTech where finance meets IT: banking, digital payments and secure systems, taught jointly with the University of Latvia, with a joint diploma and Programming Engineer qualification.
programmes.selectionNote: Online maths entrance exam, motivation letter, reference and online interview; 2026 criteria, 2027 not yet published. Non-EU price is higher.

programmes.name: Entrepreneurship and Management
programmes.about: Social-science foundations in entrepreneurship and management with research skills, qualifying you for master's study; taught in English by the Faculty of Engineering Economics and Management.
programmes.selectionNote: Online maths entrance exam, motivation letter, reference and online interview; 2026 criteria, 2027 not yet published. Non-EU price is higher.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Riga Business School management degree made with BI Norwegian Business School and the University at Buffalo, with focuses on AI and data, marketing, finance and entrepreneurship.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma holders are exempt from the English test; two references are required; no maths exam is listed.
programmes.selectionNote: Applications run in early, regular and rolling rounds; two references are required. 2026 rounds shown; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: early 6 Dec–19 Jan; regular 1 Feb–15 Mar; rolling to 2 Jun

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Building applications, AI and digital systems at RTU's Liepāja Academy, with practice-led teamwork on real company problems and links to the local tech hub.
programmes.selectionNote: Online maths entrance exam, motivation letter, reference and online interview; 2026 criteria, 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Marine Engineering (Maritime Transport)
programmes.about: Marine engineering at the RTU Latvian Maritime Academy leading to the professional qualification Ship's Engineer; 4.3 years (278 ECTS).
programmes.ib: A seafarer medical certificate is required before acceptance.
programmes.selectionNote: Maths exam, interview and a seafarer medical certificate before acceptance; the portal showed no autumn 2026 intake, so confirm 2027 with RTU.

programmes.name: Navigation (Maritime Transport)
programmes.about: Navigation at the RTU Latvian Maritime Academy leading to the professional qualification Navigator; 4.3 years (278 ECTS).
programmes.ib: A seafarer medical certificate is required before acceptance.
programmes.selectionNote: Maths exam, interview and a seafarer medical certificate before acceptance; the portal showed no autumn 2026 intake, so confirm 2027 with RTU.

notes: Most degrees cost the same for EU and non-EU students; Computer Systems, Finance Management Information Systems, Entrepreneurship and Management and Business Administration have a lower EU/EEA price.
The application fee is 165 euro (150 at Riga Business School) and the portal lists a 250 euro deposit; the fee is paid per year of study.
Some degrees also start in January; the autumn intake is the one for IB Diploma results.
